QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Building a Catapult
QuestInfo.0: Alika is having a serious conversation with some of the workers. You should see if there is anything you can help with.
QuestInfo.1: Alika is making a catapult. The framework and the rocks it will launch are ready, but there's no rope in Skaus strong enough to handle the weight of the rocks. Maybe you can find something in the forest strong enough to be used as rope.
QuestInfo.2: The ropes you got from the Jellyrash monsters in the forest were perfect for completing the catapult. And just in time, too! The falling pink snow within the forest was the first sign of the attack.
